title: No Channels Left Behind: Understanding Diffusion Acceleration through Residual Gates
abstract: arXiv:2610.40914v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Training acceleration methods for diffusion transformers, such as REPA and dispersive regularization, are commonly explained by additional supervision, spatial-structure priors, or improved feature geometry. We revisit this view and uncover a striking internal change: the AdaLN-Zero residual gate $\alpha$, which directly controls how conditioned updates enter the residual stream, is substantially reorganized by these methods. This observation motivates our hypothesis that acceleration arises, at least in part, from reshaping the residual gating pathway rather than solely from the feature structures explicitly imposed by auxiliary objectives. Supporting this view, accelerated models are markedly more sensitive to perturbations of $\alpha$, and their gate geometry reflects semantic relationships among classes. translated_title: 不让任何一个通道掉队：通过残差门控理解扩散模型加速
translated_abstract: 针对扩散变换器的训练加速方法，如REPA和色散正则化，通常被解释为通过额外监督、空间结构先验或改进的特征几何来实现。我们重新审视了这一观点，并揭示了一个显著的内部变化：AdaLN-Zero残差门控α——它直接控制条件化更新如何进入残差流——被这些方法大幅地重新组织了。这一观察促使我们提出假设：加速效果至少部分来自于残差门控通路的重塑，而不仅仅来自辅助目标所显式施加的特征结构。支持这一观点的证据是，加速后的模型对α的扰动明显更加敏感，且其门控几何结构反映了类别之间的语义关系。我们进一步引入了归一化参与率来刻画门控的通道级组织方式，并发现……
tldr: 该论文揭示了REPA等扩散模型训练加速方法的本质在于大幅重组AdaLN-Zero残差门控通路，而非仅仅依赖辅助目标强加的特征结构，并提出了归一化参与率（nPR）来刻画门控的通道级组织方式。
en_tdlr: This paper reveals that diffusion training acceleration methods like REPA fundamentally work by substantially reorganizing the AdaLN-Zero residual gating pathway rather than solely through feature structures imposed by auxiliary objectives, and introduces the normalized participation ratio (nPR) to characterize the channel-wise organization of the gates.
